entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Bith reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Biths' benevolent nature causes them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Bith typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 120 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Detail Oriented
entries: You are {@feat Practiced|sw5e-phb|practiced} at scouring for details. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) checks within 5 feet.

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve hearing or smell.

entries.name: Musician
entries: You are proficient in one musical instrument of your choice.

entries.name: Programmer
entries: Whenever you make an Intelligence ({@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}) check related to computers, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Sonic Sensitivity
entries: Your powerful sense of hearing makes you especially vulnerable to deafening sounds. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against effects that would deal sonic damage (explained in chapter 9).

entries.name: Trance
entries: You only need 3 hours of sleep during a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} to gain its benefits, instead of 6. Additionally, if your {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} would be interrupted, you only need to complete the {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} instead of restarting it to gain its benefits.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, Bith, and one more language of your choice.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Bothans reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Bothans' duplicitous nature causes them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Bothans stand 4-5 feet tall and weigh under 100 pounds. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Naturally Stealthy
entries: You can attempt to hide even when you are obscured only by a creature that is your size or larger than you.

entries.name: Nimble Escape
entries: You can take the Disengage or {@action Hide|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on each of your turns.

entries.name: Shrewd
entries: You are proficient in the {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb} and {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb} skills.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Bothese. Bothese had a great influence on the forming of {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}; the two languages share many cognates.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Cathar reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Cathar tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.

entries.name: Size
entries: Cathar range from 5 to 7 feet tall, and can weigh up to 300 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Cat's Claws
entries: Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Your vision can easily cut through {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can’t discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Leonine Agility
entries: Your reflexes and agility allow you to move with a burst of {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. When you move on your turn in combat, you can double your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} until the end of the turn. Once you use this trait, you can’t use it again until you move 0 feet on one of your turns.

entries.name: Silent Step
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Treeclimber
entries: You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} and Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve climbing.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Catharese.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Cereans reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Cereans' altruistic nature causes them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Cereans typically stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and weigh about 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Intuitive Initiative
entries: You can choose to reroll {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb} checks, but you must use the new roll.

entries.name: Natural Instinct
entries: You have proficiency with {@skill Nature|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} (your choice).

entries.name: Prediction
entries: You can embrace the Force and use your advanced insight to predict likely outcomes, allowing you to turn failures into successes. When you roll a 1 on an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

entries.name: Second Heart
entries: When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can’t use this feature again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Trance
entries: You only need 3 hours of sleep during a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} to gain its benefits, instead of 6. Additionally, if your {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} would be interrupted, you only need to complete the {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} instead of restarting it to gain its benefits.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Cerean. Cerean is characterized by its gravelly sounds.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Chiss reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Chiss' tactical and selfish nature cause them to tend toward lawful dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Chiss typically stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh about 160 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Martial Proficiency
entries: You have proficiency with light and {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor} as well as the {@item Heavy pistol|sw5e-phb} and {@item Sniper rifle|sw5e-phb|sniper rifle}.

entries.name: Politically Minded
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Tech Resistance
entries: Growing up around technology leaves an impact on chiss. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity and Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

entries.name: Superior Darkvision
entries: Your vision can easily cut through {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}. You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can’t discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, Cheunh, and your choice of Minnisiat or Sy Bisti. Cheunh is a complex language that is difficult for non-chiss to learn. Chiss take pride in this difficulty. Communications with outsiders are conducted through local trade-languages like Minnisiat or Sy Bisti.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Devaronians reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Devaronians' greediness causes them to tend toward chaotic balanced, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Devaronians typically stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh about 160 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Curiosity
entries: You have proficiency with {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb} (your choice).

entries.name: Heat Adaptation
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} due to extreme heat.

entries.name: Jungle Dweller
entries: Growing up in the jungles of Devaron has left an impact. You don’t treat jungle terrain as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}.

entries.name: Silver Tongue
entries: You have proficiency with {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} (your choice).

entries.name: Tech Resistance
entries: Growing up around technology leaves an impact on devaronians. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity and Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

entries.name: Two Livered
entries: Devaronians have two livers, which makes them adept at filtering toxins. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison}, and you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} against {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage (explained in chapter 9).

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Devaronese. Devaronese is characterized by grunts and grumbles. It is rare to hear a Devaronian speak it anywhere other than their homeworld of Devaron.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Wisdom or Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Droids don't age, though they require maintenance to retain functionality.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Droids tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.

entries.name: Size
entries: Class I droids stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh about 170 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

entries.name: Type
entries: Your creature type is droid.

entries.name: Armor Integration
entries: You can not wear armor, but you can have the armor professionally integrated into your chassis over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. This work must be done by someone proficient with {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements}. You must be proficient in armor in order to have it integrated.

entries.name: Droid Resistances
entries: You are resistant to necrotic, {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison}, and psychic damage, and are immune to {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} and disease.

entries.name: Droid Systems
entries: You do not need to eat, drink, or breathe. Additionally, you no longer require a tech focus to cast {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

entries.name: Droid Vulnerabilities
entries: You are vulnerable to ion damage. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against effects that would deal ion or lightning damage.

entries.name: Force-Insensitive
entries: While droids can be manipulated by many {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, they can not sense the Force. You can not use {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} or take levels in {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} classes.

entries.name: Knowledge Protocol
entries: You have proficiency in two Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma skills of your choice.

entries.name: Maintenance Mode
entries: Rather than sleep, you must spend 3 hours performing routine maintenance during a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} to gain its benefits, during which you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks. Additionally, if your {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} would be interrupted, you only need to complete the {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} instead of restarting it.

entries.name: Rapid Reconstruction
entries: You are built with internal repair mechanisms. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can choose to spend one of your Hit Dice to recover {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}.

entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb} and {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} skills.

entries.name: Navigators
entries: You have proficiency in surveyor's implements.

entries.name: Superior Memory
entries: You can double your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} for it when you make an Intelligence ({@skill Lore|sw5e-phb}) check to recall information you have learned, or to recall the details of your experiences.

entries.name: Tech Resistance
entries: Growing up around technology leaves an impact on duros. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity and Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Durese. Durese is a common interstellar tongue used by prominent spacers and traders.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Ewoks reach adulthood in their early teens and live about 50 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Ewoks are inherently accepting, albeit naive, and tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Ewoks stand between 3 and 4 feet tall and weigh about 50 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

entries.name: Crude Weapon Specialists
entries: Ewoks are used to making do with less. You can spend 1 hour, which you can do over the course of a {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest}, crafting a weapon out of loose materials. You can craft any simple kinetic weapon, but the weapon's damage suffers a -1 penalty.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Mask of the Wild
entries: You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

entries.name: Musical Culture
entries: Ewoks incorporate music in their celebrations and rituals. You have proficiency in an instrument of your choice.

entries.name: Natural Survivalist
entries: You have proficiency in {@skill Nature|sw5e-phb} and {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Treeclimber
entries: You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 25 feet. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} and Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve climbing.

entries.name: Undersized
entries: Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields}. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Ewokese. You can understand spoken and written {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, but your vocal cords do not allow you to speak it.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Gamorreans reach adulthood in their early teens and live no more than 70 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Gamorrean culture causes them to tend toward chaos, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Gamorreans typically stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh up to 200 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Gamorrean Toughness
entries: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.

entries.name: Gamorrean Weaponry
entries: You have proficiency with the {@item Vibroaxe|sw5e-phb|vibroaxe}, {@item Vibromace|sw5e-phb|vibromace}, and {@item Vibrosword|sw5e-phb|vibrosword}.

entries.name: Savage Attacks
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Gamorrese. You can understand spoken and written {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, but your vocal cords do not allow you to speak it. Gamorrese is characterized by its grunts and squeals, and its writing is a crude, pictographic style.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Strength score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Gungans reach adulthood in their early teens and live about 70 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Gungans tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Gungans typically stand 6 to 7 feet tall and weigh about 170 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Accustomed to life underwater, you have superior vision in low light conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can’t discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Flexible
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve flexibility.

entries.name: Heat Sensitivity
entries: You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} due to extreme heat.

entries.name: Martial Proficiency
entries: You have proficiency with light and {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor} as well as the {@item Techstaff|sw5e-phb|techstaff} and {@item Vibropike|sw5e-phb|vibropike}.

entries.name: Strong-Legged
entries: When you make a long jump, you can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a number of feet up to twice your Strength score. When you make a high jump, you can leap a number of feet up into the air equal to 3 + twice your Strength modifier.

entries.name: Swim
entries: You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Gungan. When speaking {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, you often have trouble with word tenses and infinitives; this usually has a comical effect.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: One ability score of your choice increases by 2, and two other ability scores of your choice increase by 1. Alternatively, four ability scores of your choice each increase by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Humans reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Humans tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.

entries.name: Size
entries: Humans vary widely in height and build, from barely 5 feet to well over 6 feet tall. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Defiant
entries: Humans are known to be stubborn and often refuse to give up, even against the worst odds. When you or a creature you can see that can see and understand you makes an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can roll a {@dice d4} and add it to their roll (no action required). Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Human Versatility
entries: You gain proficiency in one skill, one tool, and one weapon of your choice.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and one extra language of your choice. Humans typically learn the languages of other peoples they deal with, including obscure dialects. They are fond of sprinkling their speech with words borrowed from other tongues: trandoshan curses, twi'lek musical expressions, chiss military phrases, and so on.

abilityEntry.name: Ability Score Increase:
abilityEntry.entry: One ability score of your choice increases by 2, and two other ability scores of your choice increase by 1. Alternatively, four ability scores of your choice each increase by 1.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Ithorians reach adulthood in their late teens and live an average of 85 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Ithorians tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Shorter Ithorians stand around 6 feet while taller reach over 7 and a half. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Call for Peace
entries: As an action on your turn, you can emphatically demand that your foes embrace peace, thereby distracting them. Until the end of your next turn, enemies within 10 feet of you that can see you gain {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against your allies. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: Ithorians have a great lung capacity and can hold their breath for up to 15 minutes at a time.

entries.name: Law of Life
entries: Ithorians have a sacred respect for the natural world, taking great care to preserve and study it. You have proficiency in the {@skill Nature|sw5e-phb} skill and the bioanalysis kit.

entries.name: Sonic Scream
entries: As an action, you can violently expel air in a 15-foot cone. When you do so, each creature in the area of the exhalation must make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Constitution modifier). A creature takes 2d6 sonic damage on a failed save, and half as much damage on a successful one. The damage increases to 4d6 at 5th level, 6d6 at 11th level, and 8d6 at 17th level. This ability has no effect on constructs. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Ithorese. You can understand spoken and written {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, but your vocal cords do not allow you to speak it.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Jawas are considered adults when they make their first sale and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Jawas tendency to steal and swindle causes them to tend towards the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Jawas stand around 3 to 4 feet tall and weigh about 40 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can’t discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Grovel, Cower, and Beg
entries: As an action on your turn, you can cower pathetically to distract nearby foes. Until the end of your next turn, your allies gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against enemies within 10 feet of you that can see you. Once you use this trait, you can’t use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Heat Adaptation
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} due to extreme heat.

entries.name: Tech Dabbler
entries: You know the {@i ion blast} at-will {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. When you reach 3rd level, you learn and can cast the {@i repair droid} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. When you reach 5th level, you learn and can cast the {@i hold droid} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} is Intelligence. You do not require use of a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} for these powers.

entries.name: Thieving
entries: You have proficiency in the Sleight of Hand skill.

entries.name: Tinker
entries: You have proficiency with tinker’s implements. You can use these and spend 1 hour and 100 cr worth of materials to construct a Tiny Device (AC 5, 1 hp). You can take the {@action Use an Object|sw5e-phb} action to have your device cause one of the following effects: create a small {@spell Explosion|sw5e-phb|explosion}, create a repeating loud noise for 1 minute, create smoke for 1 minute, cause a small electrical fire. You can maintain a number of these devices up to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} at once, and a device stops functioning after 24 hours away from you. You can dismantle the device to reclaim the materials used to create it.

entries.name: Undersized
entries: Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can’t use heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields}. Additionally, you can’t use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Jawaese (and the Jawa Trade Language). You can understand spoken and written {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, but your vocal cords do not allow you to speak it. Jawaese blends quickly spoken, semi-meaningless syllables with scents to be understood. To more easily bargain and trade with other species, they rely on a simplified variant called the Jawa Trade language which removes the use of scent.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Kel dor reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Kel dors' structured nature causes them to tend toward lawful balanced, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Kel dor typically stand around 6 feet tall and weigh about 160 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Your natural evolution allows you to see what others do not in dim and dark conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Foreign Biology
entries: You cannot breathe oxygen. The kel dors have created a breathing apparatus to negate the negative effects of living in an oxygen rich environment, but if your mask is removed while you are in such an environment, you lose consciousness.

entries.name: Life in the Void
entries: You have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to necrotic damage, and while exposed to the vacuum of space, you can {@optfeature Survive|sw5e-phb|survive} for a number of hours equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1 hour), instead of a number of rounds.

entries.name: Telepathy
entries: You can communicate telepathically with creatures within 30 feet of you. You must share a language with the target in order to communicate in this way.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Kel Dor.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Intelligence or Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Mon calamari reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Mon calamaris' love of the arts cause them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Mon calamari stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and rarely weigh more than 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Accustomed to life underwater, you have superior vision in low light conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Mon Calamari Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against effects that grant the {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} condition and you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} against cold damage (explained in chapter 9).

entries.name: Musical
entries: You have proficiency in one musical instrument of your choice.

entries.name: Swim
entries: You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, Mon Cal, and one language of your choice.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Nautolans reach adulthood in their early teens and live about 70 years on average.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Nautolans' benevolence cause them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Nautolans typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and rarely weigh more than 160 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Acute Smell
entries: Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check involving smell, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Accustomed to life underwater, you have superior vision in low light conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can’t discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Hide
entries: You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 12 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Natural Empathy
entries: Nautolan head tentacles are adept at determining moods. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) checks to determine emotions against humanoids and beasts within 10 feet of you.

entries.name: Swim
entries: You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Nautila. Nautila is unique in that it can only be properly pronounced underwater due to its use of pheromones in addition to spoken sounds. In any other environment, the language loses a great amount of detail; that nautolans find this annoying.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Rodians reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Rodian culture's violent focus causes them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Rodians typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and weigh 160 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Adept Climbers
entries: You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Your vision can easily cut through {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can’t discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve hearing or smell.

entries.name: Stalking Hunter
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} and {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} skills.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Rodese. Rodians can communicate with each other using pheromones. Force-sensitives can detect this communication, though they can’t understand it.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Strength or Dexterity score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Sith reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: The cruelty of the Sith causes them to tend toward chaotic dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Sith generally stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh less than 200 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Your vision can easily cut through {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can’t discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Force-Sensitive
entries: You know the {@i denounce} at-will {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. When you reach 3rd level, you learn and can cast the {@i curse} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. When you reach 5th level, you learn and can cast the {@i bestow curse} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} is Charisma for these powers.

entries.name: Keen Senses
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Menacing
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Sith. Sith is an agglutinative language, in which words or even phrases were made up of linears sequences of distinct meaningful units.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Strength or Dexterity score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Togruta reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Togruta culture focuses on unity which causes them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Togruta typically stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Mask of the Wild
entries: You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

entries.name: Montral Reception
entries: You have {@sense Tremorsense|sw5e-phb|tremorsense} out to 30 feet. You can detect and pinpoint the origin of vibrations within a specific radius, provided that you and the source of the vibrations are in contact with the same ground or substance. {@sense Tremorsense|sw5e-phb} can’t be used to detect flying or incorporeal creatures.

entries.name: Wild Hunters
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Togruti. Togruti is an ornate language characterized by trills and long vowel sounds which are modified by subtle tremors in the togruta’s head-tails. This language is heavily influenced by Basic, but also incorporates some native idioms, which cause Basic-speaking togruta to use seemingly strange expressions.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Trandoshans reach adulthood in their early teens and rarely live to be older than 70.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Trandoshans tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Trandoshans stand as tall as 7 and a half feet and can weigh over 300 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Your vision can easily cut through {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can’t discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Hide
entries: You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 12 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Regenerative
entries: When you take damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a Hit Die to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} as long as the damage would not reduce your {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to 0.

entries.name: Saving Face
entries: Trandoshans are careful not to show weakness in front of their allies, for fear of losing status. If you miss with an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} or fail an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can gain a bonus to the roll equal to the number of allies you can see within 30 feet of you (maximum bonus of +5). Once you use this trait, you can’t use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Dosh. Dosh is characterized by its harsh grunts, hisses and growls, and its written form that used alphabetic glyphs.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Strength or Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Tuskens are considered adults when they turn 15. Because of the harsh and unforgiving climate of their home world, they rarely live longer than half a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Tusken culture's violent focus and disregard of those outside the tribe causes them to tend towards chaotic dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Tusken stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh around 155 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Aggressive
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can move up to your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} toward an enemy of your choice that you can see or hear. You must end this move closer to the enemy than you started.

entries.name: Animal Handler
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Animal Handling|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Desert Protection
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against being {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded}.

entries.name: Fearsome Roar
entries: Once per day, you can cast the {@i fear} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. Charisma is your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} for this power.

entries.name: Survivors of the Sands
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} skill. Additionally, you don’t treat desert terrain as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}. Lastly, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} due to extreme heat.

entries.name: Tech-Impaired
entries: While tuskens can figure out basic technology, they experience difficulty using more complex equipment like wristpads. You can not use {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or take levels in {@book techcasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} classes.

entries.name: Tusken Weaponry
entries: You have proficiency with the {@item Cycler rifle|sw5e-phb|cycler rifle} and {@item Vibroaxe|sw5e-phb|vibroaxe}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak Tusken, and speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}. Tusken is a guttural language characterized by its barks, growls, and roars. While Tuskens typically understand {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, it is rare to hear them speak anything but Tusken. Tusken has no written form. Tuskens also know a complex sign language used to communicate with other tuskens silently.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Twi'leks reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Twi'leks harsh upbringing cause them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Twi'leks stand between 5 and 7 feet tall and weigh up to 200 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Charismatic
entries: You have proficiency with {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} (your choice).

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Your vision can easily cut through {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can’t discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Elegant Dancers
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Performance|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Natural Antitoxins
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} and disease, and you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} against {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage (explained in Chapter 9).

entries.name: Unarmed Combatant
entries: Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Twi’leki. You can communicate non-verbally with other twi’leks through a complex language of subtle head-tail motions.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Wisdom or Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Weequay reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Weequay ruthlessness and greed cause them to tend toward chaotic dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Weequay typically stand about 6 feet tall and weigh 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Savage Attacks
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can roll one of the weapon’s damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit}.

entries.name: Tanned
entries: You have tough, leathery skin. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. Additionally, You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} due to extreme heat.

entries.name: Weapon Training
entries: You have proficiency in two {@filter vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon} or {@filter blasters|items|firearm=true} of your choice.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Sriluurian. You can communicate with other Weequay within 30 feet without speaking through use of pheromones. Force attuned individuals can detect the communication but can’t understand it.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Wookiees reach adulthood at about 40 and can live to be 400.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Wookiees tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Wookiees tend to tower over other species, reaching heights over 8 feet and weighing 300 pounds. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Your vision can easily cut through {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can’t discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Hide
entries: You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} due to extreme cold.

entries.name: Menacing
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.

entries.name: Treeclimber
entries: You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} and Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve climbing.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Shyriiwook. You can understand spoken and written {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, but your vocal cords do not allow you to speak it.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Strength or Dexterity score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Zabraks reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Zabraks tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.

entries.name: Size
entries: Zabraks stand anywhere from 5 to 7 feet tall and weigh up to 300 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Coercive
entries: You have proficiency with {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} (your choice).

entries.name: Crafters
entries: You have proficiency with one set of artisan’s implements of your choice.

entries.name: Second Heart
entries: When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can’t use this feature again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Toughness
entries: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

entries.name: Unarmed Combatant
entries: Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Zabraki.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Bith are craniopods with pale pink, yellow, or green skin, large heads, large lidless eyes, toeless feet, and long fingers. Their thumb and small finger were both fully opposable. The bith's internal systems are different from most humanoids, as the bith have only one lung, and exhale through their skin. Bith also lack a proper nose, instead having highly sensitive olfactory organs hidden in the skin-flaps of their cheeks.

The other bith senses are also acute. Bith can sense the tonal qualities of sound as well as other species sensed colors. Their eyes, as big as a Menahuun's, can see microscopic details of nearby objects, but are extremely nearsighted as a result. An interesting side effect of their incredible sensors is the effect of sonic grenades, or screamers, on them. It is described as causing their heads to explode. Similarly, bith have high manual dexterity which helps them manipulate fine tools, though their physical prowess with gross motor skills was only average.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Bith are one of the galaxy's most ancient civilizations, with a history going back millions of years. This antiquity garners respect in certain quarters, such as among the Gree, who gave them more respect than other, "younger" species. Their society is highly regimented, with everything from mate selection to political leadership controlled by sophisticated computer programs.

entries.name: Names
entries: Bith names are quite diverse. Some names look complicated and difficult to pronounce, while others are quite simple.
{@b Male Names.} Fedu, Jenkiss, Kabadons, Ph'teumkiass {@b Female Names.} Duhia, F'hubama, R'hothal, Thidus {@b Surnames.} D'intes, Hern, K'sarorn, Nimum, Rumo

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Bothans are a short species of furry humanoids. Bothans are covered in fur which shifted in response to their emotional state by way of gentle ripplings. It is this trait, named Wrendui, that betrays them when members of their kind intend to be duplicitous in their dealings with others. They possess tapered pointed ears, and both males and females were known to sport beards.
Bothans are able to interbreed with the other species, though it is rare that they do so. Such hybrids somewhat resembled baseline humans with haunches, hooves, fur, pointed ears and a long tail.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Bothan culture is guided by the philosophy and principles from the ancient text known as The Way, written by Golm Fervse'dra. In this "Bothan Way", the pursuit of power and influence is paramount. Thus, individual bothans put their own political and economic success above all other concerns, and as a species, bothans put their own advancement ahead of other intergalactic interests. The volume of backstabbing, subtle character assassination and political maneuvering in bothan society is dizzying, and results in many species stereotyping bothans as untrustworthy. In fact, most bothans are habitually paranoid, believing that anyone who's not working with them, is working against them. In times of crisis, the focus of bothan society shifts to a {@feat Survivalist|sw5e-phb|survivalist} state known as "ar'krai". When engaged in ar'krai, all fit bothans volunteer to defend their species from impending extinction.

entries.name: Names
entries: Male bothan names are often trickey while female's are soft. Surnames are familial.
{@b Male Names.} Garc, Hibriak, Nith, Tramom, Ventagt {@b Female Names.} Ceerriah, Dhaim, Gnam, Meenn, Vit {@b Surnames.} Bwif'livi, Gra'kit, Hia'faitu, Main'dil

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The Cathar have fur-covered bodies with thick manes as well as prominent, retractable claws that can deliver powerful killing attacks on foes and prey. Their bodies also possess rapid healing abilities. These traits make them the perfect hand-to-hand specialists.

The Cathar species also has two subspecies, known as the Juhani and the Myr Rho. Both of these are notably less catlike than mainline Cathar. Cathar are born into a litter. The Cathar species is biologically similar to the Bothan species.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: On their homeworld, Cathar live in cities built into giant trees, and are organized into clans governed by elders. Stories of their great heroes were often carved into the trunks of these tree-homes for following generations to see. The Cathar mate for life, to the extent that when one mate dies, the survivor never has a relationship with another. Cathar clan society includes great pageants and celebrations, especially for their heroes. Their religion includes a ritual known as the "Blood Hunt," in which Cathar warriors individually engaged in combat against entire nests of Kiltik in order to gain honor and purge themselves of inner {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}. The native language of the Cathar is Catharese, which included the emphasis of some spoken words with a growl.

entries.name: Names
entries: Cathar names can sound both melodic and fairly gutteral, but they almost always sound strong and fierce. Female names are typically longer than male names. Surnames are usually one syllable.
{@b Male Names.} Crurbirr, Isyrr, Nynorr, Suro, Tukarr {@b Female Names.} Cuwin, Jyvohr, Mulahr, Solyri {@b Surnames.} Jin, Ki, Mak, Rhir, Ta

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The Cereans' enlarged skulls, extending above their foreheads, house complex binary brains, provided with sufficient blood by an extra heart in their heads. The binary structure of Cerean thinking helps them to ponder two sides of an issue at once. It also enables them to process information and solve problems rapidly and provides a highly advanced capacity for {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} and meditation. Because of their thoughtful nature, they tend to be calm, rational and analytical, preferring peaceful philosophies and a lifestyle which works in harmony with nature. Though the quick-thinking Cereans have equally quick reflexes, they are commonly not as well coordinated as humans.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Cereans developed a low-tech society on their homeworld and prefer to live in isolation from the wider galaxy. Preserving the natural beauty of Cerea, the planet is home to many Outsider Citadels where it is permissible to use offworld technology, though it could not be removed from the Citadel. Meditation is a core part of a Cerean's daily rituals, with many employing specially-forged kasha crystals as a focusing tool. By focusing one's thoughts while in contact with such crystals, distractions are eliminated, creating an exceptional meditation environment. Cerean Jedi sometimes incorporate these crystals into their lightsabers, providing great focus, even during intense physical combat.

entries.name: Names
entries: Cerean male first names are often hyphenated, while females are not. Surnames are familial.
{@b Male Names.} Ji-Cheelia, Ki-Adi, Pick-toh, Sauli-Fanz {@b Female Names.} Dreash, Kilniavy, Melm, Rharoth {@b Surnames.} Codux, Emkom, Kyureft, Lonnik, Mundi

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The chiss are a near-human species distinguished by their blue skin and glowing red eyes. Genetic analysis indicate that they are an offshoot of humanity, and it is believed that moving underground led to a divergence between them and baseline Humans. Their blue skin, jet black hair and red eyes generally command attention; these features make them physically striking and instantly recognizable.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Chiss society is highly structured and ordered with the rule of law being enforced by a group of four affiliations known as the Ruling Families: the Csapla, Nuruodo, Inrokini and Sabosen. These are not biological family groupings but instead different branches of their government. Every chiss claims affiliation to one of the four families, as determined by both tradition and place of birth. The family names are more of a cultural holdover; the bloodlines had grown so co-meddled that any chiss could claim affiliation to any of the ruling families. In spite of the outward impression of calm and order that the chiss like to {@spell Project|sw5e-phb|project} to outsiders, there were evidently tensions within the Families; political assassinations are a real part of chiss political life for the Ruling Families.

entries.name: Names
entries: A chiss true-name has 3 parts, each separated by an apostrophe. The first part is their family name, the second part is their root name, and the third part is their occupation. Chiss rarely share their true-name with non-chiss, and usually go by their root name. Male and female names do not significantly deviate.
{@b Names.} Crorcu'ecuk'unist, Dash'esoru'ishur, Jerd'ecer'lonii, Kisk'egauw'eqhi, Marag'aliphil'eduo, Pommo'icuote'nlerme, Vornu'wuzi'lerdim

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: A bipedal mammalian species, Devaronians evolved in the dense jungles of Devaron as a hunter-gather species. Their bodies are denser than most humanoids' and as a result they were heavier than their appearance would tend to indicate. Devaronians have silver-based blood, which appears thick and black when exposed. They possess a unique blood filtration and cleansing system which processes through two livers. Because their bodies are constantly cleansed of toxins and carcinogens, the species is highly resistant to {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison}. To this end, sulfur is used as a stimulant on Devaron to enhance {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} and strength, because inhaling it causes the substance to enter the bloodstream rapidly. Their livers struggle to eliminate sulfur from their system, meaning that long-term use can be dangerous.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Devaronian males are driven by an urge to wander, usually taking the first opportunity to move on from one place to another; they are often found traveling the galaxy as tramp freighter captains and scouts. Female Devaronians, on the other hand, are content to remain in a single location, raising the young and running the government of Devaron. The males send money back to their homeworld to support their families, but otherwise hardly ever return. The females are content with this arrangement, as they tend to view the restless males as disruptive to home life.

entries.name: Names
entries: Devaronian names are dark, complex and often guttural, with some harsher tones mixed in here and there.
{@b Male Names.} Cir, Gremegris, Keirtihk, Kucx, Niruhk {@b Female Names.} Crilnuy, Ghal, Milma, Nola, Taoluel {@b Surnames.} Breiz, Droddost, G'vaulnel, Raokt

entries.name: Appearance
entries: Class I droids are typically vaguely human-like in both shape and size, standing at around 6 feet, although some are smaller. They are usually a polished metallic color, though this can vary based on tasks for which they are created, their affiliation, or quirks of their owner.

entries.name: Utility
entries: Class I droids are programmed for the mathematical, medical, or physical sciences. Subcategories of the first degree are medical droids, biological science droids, physical science droids, and mathematics droids.
Medical droids, also known as meddroids, med droids, medical units or surgical droids are a type of droid designed to heal living beings, and are the most commonly found Class I droids.

entries.name: Names
entries: Droids are typically called by their designation, given to them when they are created, or some affectation given to them by their owner. Often this affectation is a play on their designation. Occasionally, noteworthy droids will earn monikers based on their accomplishments.
{@b Designations (Names).} 2MED2 (Toomedtoo), GH-7 (Geeaych-Seven), TX-20 (Tee-Ex Twenty)

entries.name: Appearance
entries: Class II droids are typically small, standing between two and four feet. Their form and color scheme vary based on tasks for which they are created, their affiliation, or quirks of their owner.
They are noteworthy for their distinct, function-oriented form.

entries.name: Utility
entries: Class II droids are programmed for engineering and other technical sciences. They differ from class one droids because they apply the science to real-life situations. Class II droids are rarely equipped with Basic vocabulators, instead communicating through {@language Binary|sw5e-phb|Binary}. There are five subcategories of class II droids. Astromech, exploration, environmental, engineering, and maintenance droids are all class II droids.

entries.name: Names
entries: Droids are typically called by their designation, given to them when they are created, or some affectation given to them by their owner. Often this affectation is a play on their designation. Occasionally, noteworthy droids will earn monikers based on their accomplishments.
{@b Designations (Names).} BB-5 (Beebees), CH-33P (Cheep),  OC-JK14 (Seejay), PT-7 (Poot), RG-G1 (G-G)

entries.name: Appearance
entries: Class III droids are typically human-like in both shape and size, standing at around 6 feet. They are usually a polished metallic color, though this can vary based on tasks for which they are created, their affiliation, or quirks of their owner.
They are noteworthy for their slow, shuffling gait and typically overly talkative nature.

entries.name: Utility
entries: Class III droids are programmed to interact with humans. They are said to be the most advanced droids ever invented. Protocol, servant, tutor, and child care droids are all class III droids.
They are usually equipped with protocol chips which give them the cognitive functionality to engage socially.

entries.name: Names
entries: Droids are typically called by their designation, given to them when they are created, or some affectation given to them by their owner. Often this affectation is a play on their designation. Occasionally, noteworthy droids will earn monikers based on their accomplishments.
{@b Designations (Names).} K-OHN (Kone), I-5YQ (I-Five), O-MR1 (Omri), TC-14 (Teesee Fourteen)

entries.name: Appearance
entries: Class IV droids are typically human-like in both shape and size, though there are many advanced models (such as droidekas) that forgo this standardization. They are usually colored to match their affiliation, though personally owned class IV droids might not be. Certain models of class IV droids, such as the HK-series, are made to look like class III droids to disguise their martial nature.

entries.name: Utility
entries: Class IV droids are programmed for military and security purposes. Such droids tend to perform tasks of violence or combat might be expected. Almost all class IV droids carry weapons. Armed combat droids are among the first droids ever created. Security, gladiator, battle, and assassin droids are all class IV droids.

entries.name: Names
entries: Droids are typically called by their designation, given to them when they are created, or some affectation given to them by their owner. Often this affectation is a play on their designation. Occasionally, noteworthy droids will earn monikers based on their accomplishments.
{@b Designations (Names).} K-2SO (Kay-Tuesso), PZ-99 (Peezee-Ninety-Nine), VL-44 (Vee-El Forty-Four)

entries.name: Appearance
entries: Class V droids are typically vaguely human-like in both shape and size, standing at around 6 feet, although many can be larger. They are usually a polished metallic color, though this can vary based on tasks for which they are created, their affiliation, or quirks of their owner.
They are noteworthy for their simple programming and quiet, focused work habits.

entries.name: Utility
entries: Class V droids are programmed for menial and low-skill tasks. Such droids tend to perform basic tasks such as construction, lifting, maintenance, mining, sanitation, and transportation. Labor droids are fifth-degree droids.

entries.name: Names
entries: Droids are typically called by their designation, given to them when they are created, or some affectation given to them by their owner. Often this affectation is a play on their designation. Occasionally, noteworthy droids will earn monikers based on their accomplishments.
{@b Designations (Names).} CO-34 (See-Oh Three Four), FX-9 (Effex), PK-4 (Pook), SAE-B13 (Sable)

entries.name: Biology and Appearence
entries: The duros are humanoids with smooth blue-green skin, red eyes, lipless mouths, long thin noseless faces and green blood. Olfactory organs beneath their eyes are responsible for their sense of smell. Both females and males are bald, though both genders are easily distinguished. Their large red goggle-like eyes have slit pupils. Duros females lay eggs as they are descended from ancient reptiles, and they are born in a larval grub stage. Unlike similar species, the duros take care of their offspring from birth.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Their home planet Duro is primarily uninhabited due to massive pollution on the world over time. Instead, it is covered with automated farms for food production. The duros live in twenty orbital space cities above the planet.

The duros also established a vast, grand starship construction industry in the Duro system. The duros set up their government around a consortium of starship construction corporations, with all important political decisions made by the stockholders of the corporations. This meant that any duros that held stock in a company could participate in the administration of the system.

With their strong memories, some duros also choose to become extraordinary storytellers, renowned galaxy-wide for their ability to learn a wide range of narratives by heart, and perform them all with stunning accuracy.

entries.name: Names
entries: Duros names are generally melodic, with female names having softer intonations. Surnames are familial.
{@b Male Names.} Cir, Fod, Mom, Rur, Zim {@b Female Names.} Chochi, Fumsu, Kaleshef, Raada {@b Surnames.} Dektuks, Jimoks, Silt, Tuzig, Zhoks

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Ewoks are sentient humanoid mammals, averaging about one meter in height, which can provide an {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} when trying to hide. They are covered in fur from head to toe, with brown and black the most common colors. Other Ewoks have near-white or reddish fur, but red fur is supposedly the rarest shade an Ewok can get. Most Ewoks have solid-colored fur, though a few sport stripes. Ewoks have large, bright eyes, small humanoid noses, and hands that possess two fingers and an opposable thumb. Despite their small size, Ewoks are physically strong enough to overpower combat-trained Humans. Their appearance has been likened to "little bears," though they are sometimes referred to as "mini Wookiees."

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Most Ewoks live high among the trees of the forest moon, in villages built between the closely spaced trees. The basic design of a tree village has a "Central Village" of thatched-roof huts on the primary limbs. These huts are high enough above the ground to be out of reach of predators. Suspended bridges connect the gaps between trees, adjoining distant huts. Knotted rope ladders allow access up or down.

Ewoks enjoy singing and playing music during celebrations and rituals. They are resourceful and tend to make use of everything they get their hands on; they use a variety of crude drums, horns, flutes, and other instruments in their music.

entries.name: Names
entries: Ewok names are comprised of growled consonants. Female names always end in a vowel. Surnames are clan-based.
{@b Male Names.} Coostick, Erphek, Grarphil, Moodoo {@b Female Names.} Booshi, Chela, Fesasha, Lipe, Ypezzi {@b Surnames.} Fedrimra, Jellyng, Moomrack, Trantelaa

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Although a typical gamorrean is squat, green, and heavily built, not all shared these characteristics. Most gamorreans have a dark greenish coloration over a large portion of their bodies; however skin coloration does vary, particularly among females, with light skinned and two-toned pigmentation not uncommon. Black, brown, pinkish yellow, and even a rare white pigmentation are possible. Males tended to have less skin variation and had a greater tendency towards dark green skin perhaps because of their higher exposure to the {@spell Radiation|sw5e-phb|radiation} of the Gamorr Star. Eye coloration varied evenly between gold-yellow, blue, black and brown. The gamorreans generally put no importance on skin or eye coloration although there were some superstitions linked to certain markings.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Gamorreans are organized into clans ruled by a male warlord and his wife, who was the most powerful of the clan matrons. While the warlord and his boars are solely concerned with preparing and participating in battle with rival clans, the matrons of the clan performed all the productive work including farming, hunting, manufacturing, and running businesses. Since the amount of available arable land on Gamorr is scarce, clans often lay claim to the same piece of land, and they spend their time fighting over possession.

entries.name: Names
entries: Gamorrean names are very gutteral and rough. Male names are typically one syllable while females are two. Surnames are based on clan affiliation rather than family.
{@b Male Names.} Ark, Blarrp, Blubrak, Cuab, Shos {@b Female Names.} Dabrisz, Mernoos, Ogreb, Tagorq {@b Surnames.} Doofnarq, Griks, Lurc, Poogmokk

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Starting life as tadpoles, Gungans develop into tall beings with extremely flexible cartilaginous skeletons. Strong leg muscles allow for powerful and quick frog-kick style swimming through water as well as a remarkable jumping ability while on land. Fin-like ears (called haillu) also aid them in swimming, as well as expressing emotions like aggression, friendship, and fear. They have partially retractable eyestalks with nictitating membranes when underwater. Green eyes are unusual amongst Gungans.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Gungans are generally a generous and peaceful species. They truly love to have visitors and warmly welcome them; however, they would remain suspicious until the visitors have earned their respect. Gungans are not tolerant of anyone who threatens their peaceful culture. They have very strict laws, and will go to the extremes to punish anyone who has committed a minor crime. Vandals, for example, can be given a sentence of exile, caning, or even stoning.

If a Gungan is cast out of society, it is very difficult for them to return. If they do manage to return legally, they are often subjected to heavy discrimination. This can make life very difficult for them and can go on for months or years, until their past offenses disappear from memory. Returning back to the settlement they were exiled from illegally will sometimes result in the death penalty, especially if they brought along outsiders.

entries.name: Names
entries: Gungan names are often repeated syllables hyphenated.
{@b Male Names.} Crinn-Crinn, Gic, Noc-Noc, Wal {@b Female Names.} Hew, Khi, La-La, Phro-Phro, Yuss {@b Surnames.} Baud, Gos, Jalles, Mag, Wub

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Humans are an intelligent species that originated on Coruscant, but can be found on many other planets across the galaxy, including Naboo, Tatooine, and Alderaan. They come in two sexes, male and female, and give birth to live young. They are bipedal beings with a bilateral symmetry, having a front and a back end, as well as an upside and downside. Their bodies are comprised of a torso with a head and four limbs attached to it. The upper limbs, or arms, end in hands which had five fingers each; the lower ones, called legs, end in feet. The human fingers have multiple points of articulation, and one of them is an opposable thumb that allowed for fine manipulation. Finally, they have one head perched atop their torso. Many other species, including twi'leks, mon calamari, or zabraks, are referred to as "humanoids" because of their structural resemblance to humans.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: Humans can occupy a variety of employs, from politicians to bounty hunters, swoop racers, smugglers, or even a farmer. There exist many planetary groups of humans with their own cultures, such as the Alderaanians or the Pamarthens. Humans are the most populous species in the Galaxy.

entries.name: Names
entries: Humans are the most populace species in the Galaxy, and thus their names vary drastically based on the planet or culture with whom they reside.
{@b Male Names.} Koth, Liorz, Satapak, Tin, Vuc {@b Female Names.} Dhetia, Jhilk, Risha, Thinnih, Tonu {@b Surnames.} Jauli, Kudi, Melmi, Windu, Wobec

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: Ithorians have two mouths and four throats, allowing them to speak in stereo. Female Ithorians have two humps on the back of their head, while males have only one. They have glossy, usually brown flesh. Their reflexes and coordination are somewhat slower than that of average humanoids.

In addition to allowing them to speak their unique stereophonic language, the Ithorians' four throats also have the ability to violently expel air, resulting in a deafening and potentially concussive scream. Despite this fact, most Ithorians go their entire lives without ever resorting to violence, and so the ability remained relatively ambiguous.

entries.name: Society and Culture
